description: This Java class 'SearchUtil' provides utility methods for handling search operations within the Fineract project, including validation, SQL query building, and JSON result extraction.

classes.name: SearchUtil
classes.description: Utility class for search operations, including validation, SQL query construction, and JSON result extraction within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: mapHeadersToName
methods.description: Maps a collection of ResultsetColumnHeaderData to a Map with column names as keys.

methods.name: findFiltered
methods.description: Finds the first ResultsetColumnHeaderData matching a predicate.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered ResultsetColumnHeaderData or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: extractJsonResult
methods.description: Extracts data from a SqlRowSet into JSON objects based on specified columns.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumnNames
methods.description: Validates and converts a list of column names to JDBC column names.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumns
methods.description: Validates a list of column names against headers and returns corresponding header data.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumnName
methods.description: Validates a single column name and returns its JDBC name.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumn
methods.description: Validates a single column name and returns its header data.

methods.name: buildQueryCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clause conditions based on column filters.

methods.name: buildFilterCondition
methods.description: Builds individual filter conditions for SQL queries.

methods.name: buildCondition
methods.description: Constructs SQL condition string with placeholders and adds parameters.

methods.name: parseJdbcColumnValue
methods.description: Parses a string value into the appropriate JDBC type based on column header info.

methods.name: parseColumnValue
methods.description: Converts a string value into the appropriate Java object based on column type and validation rules.

methods.name: camelToSnake
methods.description: Converts a camelCase string to snake_case.
